title: rxdiag EMULATED HW topology: CC2538 root + nRF52840 leaf, sync-vs-raw-async RX over TSCH

test.description: Emulates the hardware pairing with cc2538dk as the well-supported cooja-ng CC2538 stand-in for the Firefly (identical CC2538 SoC + cc2538_rf 2.4GHz): node 1 = CC2538 rxdiag-root (RPL root + TSCH coordinator, sender); node 2 = nRF52840 rxdiag-leaf running BOTH a simple_udp sync listener ([SU]) and a raw udp_conn tcpip_event listener ([RAW], coap-uip-like). On the leaf's trigger the root sweeps sizes {700..1000} to both leaf ports. This is the emulator BASELINE the hardware runs are compared against.
